notes: Conduit: below-window runs, feet-and-inch heights, editable conduit picks, plumb drops, Sync On/Off button.

features: In-wall conduit passing a window runs below it at the new Below window height, out of the box bottoms
Conduit heights are typed and shown in feet and inches
Sync On/Off button turns the plan / 3D selection sync on or off
fixes: Selecting a conduit no longer selects its fixtures, so the run can be edited
Conduit drops come straight down into the box instead of slanting
